balls.text: Flicks it away to deep midwicket. They look for two but the throw at the striker's end is a good one. Did Boult make it back? Nope, they get just the one run and Boult is out
Full on off, Boult goes for a big swing and skies it. Harpreet Brar runs in from deep midwicket, but he can't get there
Full around off, worked away to deep midwicket
138kph full toss on leg, Avesh manages to whip it away to deep backward square

There will be no homeground fifty for Riyan Parag! That's a dipping full toss, Parag swings across the line and is completely beaten. He is hit bang in front of the stumps on his right thigh. They take a hopeful review, but in vain. Three reds and Parag is a goner. Important innings for the team, but he would have liked to have added a few more in the final over
Full outside off, Riyan Parag looks for a big heave, but he misses
Full toss on leg, he whips it away to long-on. But they don't take the single, so that Parag can be on strike for the start of the final over
Short and wide, pace off, Boult reaches out and gets a toe end on it through to the keeper

Four more four Boulty! Don't think he knew much about that one. It was a yorker around leg, Boult was moving leg-side and looking to work it leg side. Instead it lobs up over the keeper and goes for four. PBKS review, though. They think that came off his toes. But it shows a slight inside edge as Boult went across the line!
Full toss outside off, Boult opens the face to steer it past the keeper on the off side. Deep third runs across and puts in the dive, but can't stop it
Boult looks to whack away a length ball outside off, but the ball stays low and Boult is beaten
Very full on leg, Boult misses his flick and is struck on the pad. Big appeal from Ellis, but the umpire isn't interested. That was likely going down leg. PBKS don't review
On a length outside off, Parag steers it past the point fielder and they get two more
Low dipping full toss around off, Parag taps it square on the off side and they sprint for two
Low full toss, clipped out to deep midwicket

Great take by Rilee Roussow running to his left from long-off! It's full outside off, Ferreira looks to go inside out but slices it Roussow is running along the boundary rope and grabs it above his head just inches in. A quick check confirms his foot never touched the toblerone. And Rajasthan have lost their impact player
Full on middle, swung away to deep square leg off the inside half of the bat
Full outside off, Parag reaches out and flat-bats it out to long-on
Low full toss, Parag can only drive it along the ground to long-off. Good comeback from Arshdeep after being hit for two boundaries off the first two balls
Short ball angled into him, Parag sways away under it
Full outside off, opens the face and steers it to backward point

Dropped by the bowler! It's a low full toss outside off, Parag reacts late and ends up hitting it back at Arshdeep. He sticks his left hand out, with his momentum taking him away from the ball, but spills it. He is livid
And now he goes over short third! It's full outside off, he opens the face and throws his bat at it, slicing it over the infield
Walloped along the ground for four! Arshdeep angles it into Parag, going full on off. Parag waits for it and hits it hard past the non-striker. Long-on could do nothing about that
Looks for the wide yorker, Parag squeezes it out to deep cover
Back of length outside off, pulled along the ground to deep midwicket
Drives a full delivery out to long-off

Edged past the keeper! Throws his bat at a short and wide delivery and gets a thick edge. Bairstow leaped high to his right and gets fingertips to it, but can't hold on, or stop it from racing away for four
On a length on off, punched down the ground to long-on
On a length around off, Ferreira fends at it and gets an inside edge to long leg
Drags it down around off, Ferreira unconvincingly swipes it away to deep midwicket

Beats him with a beauty! Tossed up full outside off, luring him into the drive, but the ball spins away sharply to beat the bat. Punjab Kings have reviewed for caught behind! No contact, Ultra Edge confirms, on we move
Darted full on off, punched to short cover
Caught and bowled! Wrong'un on a length outside off. Powell reads it late and looks to whip it away, but ends up lobbing it right back at Chahar, who makes no mistake. Royals continue to slide
On a length on off, he hangs back and pats it to the leg side
On a length outside off, slapped away to deep point
Length ball outside off, angling in. He taps it towards point and considers a single but is sent back
Length ball around off, Powell defends
He's in a hurry! This is full outside off from around the wicket, Powell leans into it and hits it right off the middle of the bat. It's a gorgeous cover drive and he starts off with a boundary

Catching practice to Harpreet Brar at midwicket! Back of length delivery angling into him, Jurel looks to pull but the ball hits the bat around the sticker and pops to Brar's right. He takes a simple catch as PBKS tighten their grip on this game
Full on middle and leg, clipped to backward square leg for a quick single
Starts off with a length ball angled across him, Parag punches it through point with an open face and beats the fielder's dive in the deep

Ashwin holes out at deep point! End of his little acceleration. Arshdeep angles it across him fromover the wicket, Ashwin opens the face and looks to drive it square on the off side but lofts it straight to the fielder. Shashank Singh makes no mistake!

Length ball angles in from outside off and raps him on the back foot as he tries to work it leg-side and misses. Arshdeep was interested in appealing, but the umpire doesn't give it. Parag is hobbling a bit. He took the blow high on his right thigh. Physio out to check on him
Thrashed through covers! Full and wide, Parag frees his arms and crunches it hard and deep point stood no chance
Full length ball on off, driven out to sweeper cover
Beaten on the outside edge! Arshdeep gets a full ball angled across to go past Ashwin's late drive. This was bowled at 140kph
Full on off and going across, driven square on the off side to the fielder in the deep
And now he drives inside out over extra cover! Ashwin puts the pedal to the metal. Makes room and lofts this over the infield. Just beats deep cover as well. This was a full ball on middle
Ashwin brings out the reverse scoop! Moves across, switches position early, takes on a length ball and gets it past over backward point
Clears the midwicket boundary! In the slot on middle and off, Ashwin makes room and heave it away and just gets it over the rope
Works a length ball through midwicket for a single
Full and drifting into middle and leg, Ashwin moves leg-side and drives it out to long-off
Tossed up full outside off, Parag wants to go big but can only drag it along the ground to long-on
Length ball outside off, clipped through square leg for a single
Drives a full delivery out to long-off
Full and angling in to middle, whipped away to deep square leg off his toes
Fires a full ball down leg for a wide
Punched in the gap and Parag gets a boundary! Another length ball outside off, Parag stands tall and gets it straight of the sweeper cover
Length ball outside off, punched out to sweeper cover
Starts off full around off, pinged out to deep point
cuts to deep point.
struck on the body as he's through with the sweep way too early
lofted over cover, but wasn't entirely in control of it as the bottom hand came off the bat handle.
lunges forward and works it towards the vacant midwicket region
cuts nicely but straight to deep point
shortish and into the stumps, pushed to long-on
nudged into the leg side again
tucks it gently into the leg side, excellent running to beat the man coming in from the ropes at deep midwicket as they sneak two
works it across the line towards deep midwicket
top-edges a sweep, runs away towards fine leg and they'll take two
squeezed off the inside edge to midwicket
how unlucky can he get? Ashwin goes for a big booming drive but gets a thick inside edge that races away to beat a diving Rilee Rossouw at fine leg.
driven through the line to deep cover, off the mark.
cuts again, but picks out short third.
beats him with drift and turn.  Ashwin was looking to work it to the leg side and was beaten comprehensively as this raged past the outside edge
beaten by the fizz as he rocks back to cut

more trouble for the Royals. Brave of Chahar to toss that up generously, Kohler-Cadmore goes against the turn as he tries to muscle it over long-on, but doesn't get the distance. Jitesh at the boundary rope takes it nicely, properly balanced and aware of the skirting behind him.
turn off a length on middle, whipped to deep midwicket
more pressure as he hits this straight to cover.
works it down to long-on

all that pressure that had built up courtesy the strangehold has led to Samson looking to manufacture a shot out of nothing;  picks out point in the process.  Ellis goes into the pitch again as he takes the pace off, Samson had to force the pace to try and get it up and over but couldn't. Both feet were off the ground as he made contact, just coudn't generate enough power.
driven hard but straight to mid-off
into the blockhole, dug out to long-on
slower length ball on off, turned to deep square
goes wide of the crease and bowls it into the stumps, TKC is cramped for room as he looks to force this through cover. Picks out the fielder.
excellent comeback after being hit first ball. Slower and fuller on the stumps, dug back to the bowler.
three dots in a row now. Attempts the dipping slower ball, except it doesn't dip as much, the ball beats Kohler-Cadmore's swing and hits him high on the left pad.
beats him with the off-cutter. Kohler-Cadmore was looking to hit this down town. Attempting something he would normally on the golf course
cuts well but hits it to Harpreet Brar at point
welcomes him with a rasping hit down the ground! Harshal overpitches and Kohler-Cadmore drills this back.
squeezed wide of short fine off an inside edge.
hits hard length again as he bowls on middle, pushed to Jitesh's left at cover, excellent stop
cutter into the pitch, Kohler-Cadmore beaten as he's early into the pull
opportunity missed!  Firm push to cover, a direct hit from Jitesh at the bowler's end would've had Samson. It's a wayward throw.
punched straight to mid-off
not timed well enough and it just about evades Jitesh, the cover fielder, unning back.
dabs it to short third
works this length ball on leg stump to midwicket

wow, just wow! Stands tall, opens the bat face just a touch to hit it between cover and point. Boy, that pinged the dead centre of the bat and just flew off the sweet spot. Samson knew it was four the moment he hit it.
peach. Excellent comeback as he beats him on the outside edge with an away-going delivery.
delightfully done! Picks the length early, swivels around and pulls this head-high short ball into the gap to the square leg boundary

off the edge and he's somehow managed to squeeze this past short third, Ellis does superbly well to run around from square third man and fire a flat throw on the bounce to the striker's end. Effects a direct hit but Samson was well in.
full and angled into the batter, dug out to cover. Jeez, that was struck really hard, good stop by Shashank
squirts this off a thick inside edge to midwicket, good stop by Prabhsimran
slower and fuller on the stumps, this one cuts away off the deck, Kohler-Cadmore shows the full face of the bat as he defends back
touch fuller and just around off, defends back
shades of Buttler in that! Curran drops short and Kohler-Cadmore wallops this pull from outside off. Sails way over deep midwicket.
covers the line of this full delivery as he defends back
didn't think he'd timed it as well as he would've liked, but the ball still kept gathering pace as it raced past the bowler. Mid-on, mid-off were both in pursuit, but neither of them could get there
takes the edge and flies to Bairstow's right as he dives full stretch and  takes it on the half-volley.  Excellent attempt.
skiddy short ball, Kohler-Cadmore is hurried into the pull shot as he's cramped for room, managed to get some bat on it, rolls to long leg
full and a hint of inward movement from middle and leg, worked to mid-on
beats him with one that nips away from back of a length. Kohler-Cadmore played inside the line as that zipped through
dabs it down to third man. Bowled it across Samson on a length, no swing.

tickled off the pads to the fine leg boundary. Not entirely convincing, took the inside half of the bat but the end result is what counts. As a bowler, Curran should be encouraged by the late inswing.
sumptuous flick to deep square for a single
drives on the up without any feet movement, but the late inward movement does the trick for Curran as Jaiswal smashes this onto the stumps off a thick inside edge. Curran goes on a celebratory run.
brings the ball back in from outside off this time, Jaiswal pushes this to mid-on. Big movement on that occasion for Curran
gets a good stride forward as he punches this away-going length delivery to cover point
starts with a boundary! Hint of width outside off and Jaiswal  clatters this through the covers.  No time for sighters.
And that is that! Short ball angled across him, Ashutosh just helps it along to the vacant fine leg area and they close out the win with more than an over to go
Scores are level! That's gone into the second tier! Slot ball, and he gives it the belt treatment. Clears his front leg and swings through the line
Low yorker around off, squeezed out to long-on
Picks the bones out of that! Length ball angled across him and he clears his front leg and heaves it over midwicket. Another gift for those in the stands!
Slashed in the air but it drops safely. Dug in back of a length, Ashutosh lost his shape as he looked to swing it away but it lands between the fielders on the off side
Pulled away for six! Sam Curran is on a mission here. Bouncer on leg sits up nicely around shoulder height for Curran. He nails the pull in front of square and clears the boundary comfortably
Yorker attempted on off, Ashutosh drills it out to long-off
Ashutosh manages to get his bat down to block out a leg-stump yorker

Angles a short ball across Curran, who stands tall and looks to pull it down the ground. Doesn't get a hold of it but it lands well short of long-on. Fifty up for Sam Curran. Very important innings from him
Slower ball on a length on off, Ashutosh taps it leg side for an easy single
Starts full and wide, Curran can only drive it out to the off side sweeper
Smartly played! Bouncer outside off angling in, Ashutosh waits on it before ramping it straight over the keeper for four
Almost a return catch for Avesh! Ball holds a little as Curran looks to work it leg side. Leading edge and the ball balloons up, but too high for Avesh
Length ball angled into him, Ashutosh opens the blade to run it down to deep third
Full around off, drives it towards mid-off for a quick single. The ball was in the air for a short bit but bounced well short of the fielder
Length ball on off, tapped towards point. They contemplate a single but decide against it

Length ball around off, Ashutosh works it towards point for a quick single. Jaiswal is quick to get to the ball and have a shy at the striker's end. Curran would have been in trouble with a direct hit!
Clipped away through square leg and Ashutosh is off the mark
Full around off, pushed out towards cover

Chahal gets his second. That's some excellent bowling! Chahal floats it up, and it drifts in to pitch around middle and off. Jitesh was dancing down and looking to go downtown. Ends up hitting it off the inside half of his bat. The ball does not clear long-on and Royals get a precious breakthrough
Comes out of the crease and flicks a full delivery to deep midwicket
Length ball angled across him, gave him enough room to slap it away through the gap at cover. He hit that hard!
Length ball on leg, turns away to go down for a wide
Curran works a full delivery to deep midwicket. Loses his footing as he runs back for the second and falls over. But he seems to be fine
length ball worked out to long-on
Ashwin darts in a full ball, Curran defends
Smacked flat over extra cover! 100 up for PBKS, 50-partnership up for these two. Skips out of the crease, slaps it away inside out for a six
Full delivery on leg, driven along the ground to long-on
Sent into the second tier! Carrom ball around off in the slot, Jitesh clears his front leg and wallops this far over long-on
On a length around off, fended towards cover
Angles in a pace-off length ball from outside off, Jitesh steers it with an open face to short third's right for a quick single
Full outside off, Curran flicks it out to deep midwicket
Length ball swung away along the ground to deep square leg
Length ball outside off and angling in, Jitesh clips it to midwicket
Full on the pads, clipped to fine leg and he gets a single this time
Length ball on the pads and Curran whips it away behind square on the leg side. Gets it past the fine leg fielder and that's four more for Curran
Full and angling into him, flicked away to deep midwicket
Tucked to midwicket
Full around off, punched to mid-off. Jitesh wanted the single but Curran sends him back
Full length ball outside off, pushed to point
Dropped short and that's all the invitation Curran needs. Stands tall and slaps it away past the cover fielder, who put in the dive. The off side sweeper was too far across
Full on leg, Curran works it to midwicket
Flicked behind square leg for a single to finish the over
Floated on a length on leg, he taps it through midwicket and they race for two
Clubbed wide of long-on! Skips out to a full ball and swings it away along the ground. Good placement and PBKS pick up a much-needed boundary
On a length on off, driven out to long-off
Is that a drop at cover? Oh no, fell just short of the fielder! It was full and angled across Curran, who drove it hard, but straight at the fielder
Full on middle, he clips it away through square leg
Length ball angles in from outside off, Jitesh tucks it out to deep midwicket for a single
Length ball outside off, Jitesh cuts it away to deep third's right
Back of length outside off, Jitesh looks to steer it fine on the off side and take off for a single, but the ball goes straight to backward point
Bouncer outside, Jitesh sways out of the way
Back of length outside off, he stands tall and pushes it square on the off side to point
On a length on off, Jitesh fends towards cover
Floated up full on middle and leg, tucked away on the leg side for a single
Floated up full on middle, clipped away to deep midwicket
Fires it full and across Curran, who lets it through
Full on middle and leg, Jitesh digs it out to long-off
Length ball on middle, he drives it wide of long-on
Tossed full on off, Curran sweeps it behind square and beats the infielder to pick up a boundary
good comeback, bowls the carrom ball full on the stumps, worked back to the bowler
nails that! Such moments have been far and few for Jitesh this IPL. Ashwin drops short outside off, Jitesh rocks back and wallops the pull over deep midwicket.
lunges forward and turns it back to Ashwin
cut uppishly to sweeper point
squeezes one into the leg side off the inside edge. Plenty of drift back in for Ashwin
drifts in full on middle from around the stumps, pushed to midwicket

he has finished it superbly! Tag-team effort at long-on. Bairstow sees this tossed up over his eye line outside off, he goes through with the slog sweep, but gets more elevation than distance as Donovan Ferreira takes a dolly. He lobs it gently to Parag, but only after he was well in control.
sees Curran chipping down and shortens his length, pulled to long-on
heaved away to wide long-on
works it with the spin down to deep midwicket
cut away to sweeper cover
slaps the short ball straight to cover, Bairstow's missed out
bowls a carrom ball on a length around middle, Bairstow makes room and punches to long-off
flays this shortish delivery to long-off
makes room and slaps this shortish delivery to sweeper cover
punched down to long-on
worked wide of midwicket
the ball drifts in and skids through on off stump, Bairstow looks to go back into his crease to cut but changes to a defensive shot at the last moment. Lovely start from Ashwin
turned around the corner to short fine leg
gets this cross-seam length ball to cut back into middle, defended
defends back to the bowler as Sandeep bowls a tight line again
got stuck into the pitch on a length, popped up as Bairstow defended but doesn't carry to Sandeep
punched to long-on
driven straight to cover
they'll scamper a run off an overthrow. What was Sam Curran doing? Took off as soon as the ball was hit into the off side
the roar is deafening in Guwahati! Avesh hits hard length and gets the ball to skid off the seam from off-stump, Shashank plays all around it and is hit on the pad. Stone dead.

Bairstow survives by the skin of his teeth! Shashank bunts it to short cover, Bairstow thinks they can steal a single even as Ashwin swoops in quickly to flick an under-arm throw at the bowler's end. Bairstow was back just in the nick of time.

sliced straight to point where Jaiswal takes a good, low catch. Avesh went full and across, Rossouw throws his bat at that but gets a thick edge. Was looking to go over cover, but ended up hitting it behind square.
check-punches to cover
steers this length ball straight to point
heaved over square leg! Right into his hitting arc again as Sandeep veers into leg stump
full and straight on the stumps, dug back
sat up nicely for him to wallop that pull through midwicket. Sandeep went around the wicket and tried to angle back in but didn't hit the right length.
looks to smash this low full toss through cover, gets an inside edge onto the pad as they squeeze in a single
punches this slower length ball straight to cover
makes room but Sandeep follows him by going full and straight into him, defended back
beaten by the late movement away as he tries to steer it down to third man
muscled over midwicket as he charges outside the crease. Boult digs one in again, picked away easily.
hammers the pull in front of square! Rossouw picked the length early and smashed the cover off that. Sat up nicely for him to play the stroke.
squeezes this yorker-length delivery into the leg side for a quick single.
clears mid-on! Right into Bairstow's swinging arc and he middled it.
slants one across the batter, defended with soft hands.
full on the stumps, flicked straight to midwicket
thumped on the up through extra cover! Was in the air, but if you can hit it that hard, most times only a miracle, where the ball sticks, can get you out.
heaved away into the gap at deep midwicket, Jaiswal gets around to cut that off
short of a length on middle, the ball moves away a hint as Rossouw defends
tucks it wide of short midwicket for a single
goes full, gets the ball to curve back in, Bairstow defends with the full face of the bat
beaten by late movement, not as short as Rossouw expected to try and flay that on the up through cover point.
full and swinging away from off-stump, defended back

straight up off the top-edge, Chahal running back from the edge of the ring at short third takes the swirler as it descends. Prabhsimran was in no position to play the pull, was cramped for room as he went through.
sashays down the pitch and slaps this back past the bowler. Through Boult's legs. Raced away
gets a leading edge that flies wide of the point fielder, they'll scamper back for the second as Chahal gives it chase. Top effort from inside the ring.
hint of movement back in from length outside off, Prabhsimran is right back into the crease as he defends back
